An estimate from the phone sensor, not a calibrated light meter. Position, case, shadows, sensor saturation and device hardware affect readings. Sensor-reported accuracy is not a calibration certificate. Do not rely on this for exposure, workplace compliance or safety-critical lighting decisions.

Readings are live only, not saved to history or the workbench. No camera, location, network or extra permission is needed. Values are not announced automatically on every update; focus the reading to hear it.
Open Light Meter and leave the device light sensor unobstructed. Read ambient illuminance in lux while this screen is active.
Compare the reading in a shaded room with the reading nearer a window, without covering the sensor.
Requires an actual ambient light sensor. This is not a calibrated instrument; no camera fallback, saved measurement history or automatic lighting advice is provided.
